title: 反馈支路含电容的反相放大器
statement: 理想运放电路中 U̇_s = 1∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R_1 = 1 kΩ，反馈支路为 R_f = 2 kΩ 与 C = 0.5 µF 并联。
求输出电压 U_o（o 端对地）的有效值和相位，以及电容中的电流 I_C（参考方向见图）。

questions.explain: 反相端虚地，电容两端电压 0 − U̇_o = 1 − j V，İ_C = jωC × (1 − j) = j0.5 mA × (1 − j) = 0.5 + j0.5 mA，模 0.707 mA。

questions.ask: 如果频率降得很低（ω → 0），这个电路的电压增益 |U_o/U_s| 趋于多少？
choices: 2（电容相当于开路，就是普通的反相比例放大器 −R_f/R_1）
choiceExplain: 电容相当于短路是 ω → ∞ 的情况（高频时增益才趋于 0）；ω → 0 时 1/(ωC) → ∞，电容相当于开路。
电容开路后反馈支路里还剩 R_f，Z_f → R_f 而不是 ∞，增益趋于 R_f/R_1 = 2。
questions.explain: ω → 0 时 1/(ωC) → ∞，电容支路相当于开路，Z_f → R_f，增益 → −R_f/R_1 = −2。频率越高电容分流越多，增益越小——这是一个有源低通电路。

hints: 虚短、虚断在相量形式下同样成立：反相端 n 是虚地，R_1 的电流全部流入反馈支路。
把 R_f 与 C 的并联写成一个复阻抗 Z_f，U̇_o = −(Z_f/R_1)·U̇_s。
solution: **4. 验算（结点 n 的 KCL）。** İ_Rf = (0 − U̇_o)/R_f = (1 − j)/2 mA = 0.5 − j0.5 mA，I_Rf + I_C = 1 mA = I_1 ✓。

en.title: Inverting amplifier with a capacitor in the feedback
statement: In the ideal op-amp circuit U̇_s = 1∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R_1 = 1 kΩ, and the feedback branch is R_f = 2 kΩ in parallel with C = 0.5 µF.
Find the rms value and phase of the output voltage U_o (terminal o to ground) and the capacitor current I_C (reference direction as drawn).

questions.explain: U̇_o = −1 + j = 1.414∠135° V: the inversion contributes 180° and the angle of Z_f contributes −45°.
The inverting input is a virtual ground, so the capacitor voltage is 0 − U̇_o = 1 − j V and İ_C = jωC × (1 − j) = j0.5 mA × (1 − j) = 0.5 + j0.5 mA, magnitude 0.707 mA.

questions.ask: If the frequency is made very low (ω → 0), what does the voltage gain |U_o/U_s| approach?
choices: 2 (the capacitor is an open circuit; it is the ordinary inverting amplifier −R_f/R_1)
choiceExplain: The capacitor acts as a short when ω → ∞ (the gain goes to 0 at high frequency); as ω → 0, 1/(ωC) → ∞ and it acts as an open circuit.
With the capacitor open, R_f is still in the feedback path: Z_f → R_f, not ∞, so the gain tends to R_f/R_1 = 2.
questions.explain: As ω → 0, 1/(ωC) → ∞, the capacitor branch is open, Z_f → R_f and the gain → −R_f/R_1 = −2. At higher frequencies the capacitor bypasses more current and the gain drops — this is an active low-pass circuit.

hints: Virtual short and virtual open hold for phasors too: the inverting input n is a virtual ground and all of R_1's current goes into the feedback branch.
Combine R_f and C in parallel into one complex impedance Z_f; U̇_o = −(Z_f/R_1)·U̇_s.
solution: **1. Impedances.** Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j2 kΩ, Z_f = R_f ∥ Z_C = 2k(−j2k)/(2k − j2k) = −j2k/(1 − j) = 1k − j1k Ω = 1.414 kΩ∠−45°.
**2. Virtual short and open.** U_n = 0, I_1 = U_s/R_1 = 1 mA, all of it into Z_f: U̇_o = 0 − Z_f·İ_1 = −(1 − j) V = **−1 + j V = 1.414∠135° V**.
**4. Check (KCL at n).** İ_Rf = (0 − U̇_o)/R_f = (1 − j)/2 mA = 0.5 − j0.5 mA, I_Rf + I_C = 1 mA = I_1 ✓.
